split_note: D.3 switches to TRAIN split (prior 384/624 used validation); train is disjoint from the validation eval domain (no overlap)
amplitude_metric: RMS (primary); peak_abs & crest_factor reported as coverage
selection_rule: 5 RMS-quantile bins (p50/p75/p90/p95) x SNR-quantile spread within each bin; body-weighted [4,3,3,3,3]; seeded deterministic; never max-only, never validation cherry-pick
